data_formats: Widely used file formats (Spreadsheet, JSON, GeoJSON, SHP, GPX, KML, XML, TIFF, MP3, MP4, etc.)
name: Soil data of the DigitAF living labs
description:
This dataset contains the data from a soil health assessment across eight sites in selected Living Lab farms in Portugal, Finland, Spain, Italy, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Czechia and Germany. In all sites, a consistent set of four parameters of soil health were measured, which are also required within the UKCEH Soil Health Tool. The four parameters are the level of soil organic matter (or soil organic carbon), the level of acidity (pH, in water and KCl), the soil bulk density, and the number of earthworms. Measurements of the effect of agroforestry on soil health parameters were completed following a common protocol (Aynekulu et al., 2026, annexed to the DigitAF deliverable 3.5 report by den Herder et al . 2026). However in some sites, the protocol was modified to accommodate the differences in agroforestry system design, soil type, and in some cases to allow direct comparisons with previous measurements. Hence the detailed sampling protocols are described for each of the eight sites and can be found in DigitAF deliverable 3.5 report (den Herder et al. 2026), and the metadata sheets for each country.

The Original Raw Excel data is also complemented with:

digitaf_soil_dataset_final.json - a machine readable dataset
convertdata2machinereadable.py - python code that was used to convert the raw excel to promote the accessibility of the data, making it machine readable (i.e. you can send the DOI/URL to AI agents for data analysis)
spatial_details: A soil health assessment was carried out across eight sites in selected Living Lab farms in Portugal, Finland, Spain, Italy, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Czechia and Germany. The sites included silvopastoral and silvoarable agroforestry systems. In silvoarable systems, linear-based soil sampling was performed with samples taken at a regular distance from the tree lines. In silvopastoral systems, area-based sampling (treatment vs. control) was performed, comparing grazed sites with ungrazed sites. More details can be found in the sampling protocols for each site in each country.
time_steps_other: In most sites the data were collected in 2025. In some sites (Germany), soil sampling was repeated from earlier measurements.
access_barrier: No, direct download/access through a web link

The results of the assessment are presented in DigitAf deliverable 3.5. All countries presented the results of the soil health assessment to the living lab stakeholders.
